name: Scarab of Protection
description: A beetle of polished jet with a hidden inscription under its wings.
body:
## What it does

Held for a round, it shows its inscription. From then on, while you hold it, spells have a hard time taking hold of you.

## Charges

It holds twelve and never regains them. When you fail a saving throw against a necromancy spell or the harm of an undead creature, you can spend one to succeed instead. With its last charge it crumbles to powder.

features.name: Ward
features.text: As a reaction, spend a charge to turn a failed save against a necromancy spell or an undead creature's harm into a success.
